question_pt: Quais municipios do RS tem taxa de uso de UTI acima da media estadual, considerando apenas municipios com mais de 1000 internacoes?
ground_truth_sql: WITH rs AS (SELECT m."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MARCA_UTI" <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS internacoes_uti FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE m."SG_UF" = 'RS' GROUP BY m."NO_MUNICIPIO"), media AS (SELECT SUM(internacoes_uti) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_internacoes), 0) AS taxa_media_rs FROM rs) SELECT rs.municipio, rs.total_internacoes, rs.internacoes_uti, ROUND(rs.internacoes_uti * 100.0 / NULLIF(rs.total_internacoes, 0), 2) AS taxa_uti FROM rs, media WHERE rs.total_internacoes > 1000 AND rs.internacoes_uti * 100.0 / NULLIF(rs.total_internacoes, 0) > media.taxa_media_rs ORDER BY taxa_uti DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql: WITH media_estado AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_ref FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE mu."SG_UF" = 'RS' ), por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS nome, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE mu."SG_UF" = 'RS' GROUP BY mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ) SELECT pm.nome, pm.total_internacoes, ROUND(pm.taxa, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM por_municipio pm, media_estado me WHERE pm.taxa > me.taxa_ref ORDER BY pm.taxa DESC;
